privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy - TypeWhisper
privacy.meta.description: TypeWhisper privacy policy. All data stays on your device - no collection, no tracking.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.section.overview.title: Overview
privacy.section.overview.p1: TypeWhisper is a local-first desktop app for macOS and Windows. We are committed to your privacy and designed TypeWhisper to process all data entirely on your device.
privacy.section.dataCollection.title: Data Collection
privacy.section.dataCollection.p1: TypeWhisper does not collect any data. All audio processing, transcription, and storage happens locally on your device. No audio, transcription text, or usage data is ever sent to any server.
privacy.section.localStorage.title: Local Storage
privacy.section.localStorage.p1: TypeWhisper stores the following data locally in your OS-specific app data directory (for example Application Support on macOS or AppData on Windows):
privacy.section.localStorage.p2: This data is stored only on your device and is not accessible to us or any third party.
privacy.section.network.title: Network Access
privacy.section.network.p1: TypeWhisper connects to the internet only to download AI models from Hugging Face. After models are downloaded, the app can function entirely offline.
privacy.section.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.section.thirdParty.p1: TypeWhisper does not integrate with any analytics, advertising, or tracking services.
privacy.section.securityReview.title: Law-Firm Security Review
privacy.section.securityReview.beforeLin: For firm IT and privacy review, there is also a
privacy.section.securityReview.linkText: public checklist covering data flow, storage locations, and optional cloud building blocks
privacy.section.openSource.title: Open Source
privacy.section.openSource.p1: TypeWhisper is open source under the GPLv3 license. You can audit the entire source code on GitHub.
privacy.section.contact.title: Contact
privacy.section.contact.p1: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub organization.
